description: A permission's role or expiry (or its expiry removed). Making someone the owner needs transfer_ownership: true. It changes who can open the file: do it only on the user's explicit go for this file and these people.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

file_id.description: The file's id, or its URL.
